conditions.opening_selection: Center plus three seeded samples in central 5x5; D4 colored-board deduplication, excluding previous 16 smoke openings; no outcome filtering

inference.test: exact two-sided conditional paired sign randomization
inference.increase_criterion: primary lower 95% bound > 0.5 and exact p < 0.05

posthoc_sensitivity.designation: POST HOC, descriptive sensitivity; not a replacement primary test
posthoc_sensitivity.method: One-sided exact binomial 95% upper bound U for nonneutral pair probability; expected pair score lies in [0.5-U/2, 0.5+U/2]. Same opening-population assumptions apply.

classification: Correctness repair; playing-strength increase not established
